item: One Diagnostics button builds a Quick or a Thorough archive, every file at most 4,000,000 bytes, with a machine record, a slot table and the duplicate bytes removed
key_paths: src/api/diagnostics_plan.py src/api/diagnostics_slots.py src/monitoring/machine_record.py src/api/diagnostics/bundle.py src/analytics/upload_parts.py src/static/app-diagnostics.js src/static/index.html tests/test_diagnostics_modes.py tests/test_diagnostic_slots.py tests/test_machine_record.py
summary: The panel has one Diagnostics button (the Light checkbox is gone, R122) and a Thorough checkbox, off at every open and never stored (R124). Quick, the default, runs the records first with collection still running, then the scans under the exclusive window on one shared 600 s budget, shortest first, with a 30 s floor; a scan that does not fit is named in the manifest as skipped with its estimate, never written as a smaller version of itself. Thorough keeps every scan under its own 300 s deadline as before. Every file is at most 4,000,000 bytes (R119; one file when the archive fits). The manifest header carries a machine record read once at the start (the commit the process runs, the versions of DuckDB, SQLite, SQLCipher and the C library, the memory tier the process resolved to beside the tier the machine would give now, the allocator setting, the names of the OO_ variables that are set and never a value). An owner adds a member by one function in their own module and one row in the slot table, not by editing bundle.py; a slot whose module is absent is named not-in-build and a slot whose function is missing is an error. The same bytes sat in four places of the old zip (a guard over the members' bytes now fails on any object of 300 bytes or more that appears in two members), the debug bundle can be slim and points at the members it does not repeat, and selftests.json collects the self-tests. All keywords stays a small link (R123). The hover texts are translated into the twelve languages.
